_readme: Copy ONLY the leads.fields object below over the leads.fields object in your existing adapter file.
Leave every other block (success_path, activities, calls, appointments, pipelines) exactly as it is: those were verified against your account and already worked.
Why: contactData.0.phoneNumbers.0.number does not exist. The key is phoneNumber. A wrong JSON path returns nothing WITHOUT raising, so a typo looks exactly like 'the seller has no phone'.
After editing, run from the install folder: .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\manage.py adapter-check
It prints, per field, how many sampled leads filled in. Any field at 0/5 is a wrong path, not missing CRM data.
